BenJoke.finding: Recognition of Ben plus nobody minds Ben dead or alive restores courage. No proof of Ben being alive.

BenFear.finding: Ben fears his old quartermaster; no revenge motive supplied.

SilverEscape.finding: Ben connives at escape and claims life-saving reason; story attributes that reason to Ben.

Hands.finding: One priming changed, other gun reloaded; thrown dirk, involuntary shots, shot/drowned, skin pinch release.

TreasureChronology.finding: Ben moved treasure two months before arrival. Doctor learns after assault, bargains next morning after ship disappears; rescue follows discovering Jim captive.
